messages:
Hannah: FYI - Marlin (dedicated) observed a brief peering isolation marlin-prod <-> onprem-syd during a KV checkpoint at 03:14 UTC. Symptoms: TCP retransmits + short BGP flap, ~35s degraded RPCs.
Luis: Which CIDR/appliance? pcap uploaded to ticket `pcap_2401234567.pcap`.
Tom: I'll take remediation ownership and coordinate with Marlin NOC.
marlin-net: We saw bursts of retransmits and will share firewall syslogs on request.
Hannah: Immediate triage: 1) assign owner (Tom), 2) enable ring pcap for 48h, 3) add correlation alert (checkpoint_active AND retransmit_pct>0.8%).
Luis: I'll add the pcap hooks and the alert rule. ETA: 12h. Rule suggestion: (bgp_flap OR tcp_retransmit_pct>0.8) AND kv.checkpoint.active == true.
Tom: I'll start an RCA doc and propose two mitigations: staggered checkpoint windows and runtime pacing when egress loss >0.5%. Will post draft in #incidents-wg.
ops-bot: Created PM issue PM-9902 with label `recurring-peering` and template `pm-onprem-peering-v1`. Attach `pcap_2401234567.pcap`.
Hannah: Action items recorded: Tom - owner & RCA (72h), Luis - pcap+alert (EOD), Hannah - add to recurring-peering backlog.
Tom: Also logging note: capture `kv.checkpoint.size` and `kv.checkpoint.start_ts` in peering telemetry for 60 days to help correlation.
marlin-net: We'll run MTU and queue checks and share logs.
Hannah: WG invite and postmortem link coming. Closing thread for now; will reopen if another event occurs. :thumbsup:
